minor.issue: Body='YEP' while state=INTERVIEW_INVITED advances user to INTERVIEW_STARTED (Jessi tries to place the call). Review-request spec says YEP should only count at INTERVIEW_COMPLETE. Root cause: services/jessi_onboarding.py line 41 has 'yep' in CALL_WORDS AND line 500 treats any CALL_WORDS at INTERVIEW_INVITED as call intent. If the intent is 'yep = confirm write-up only', remove 'yep' from CALL_WORDS and rely on 'call/ready/yes/etc'. If the current code is correct and the review spec is stale, ignore. Not a crash; low priority.

action_items: Decide on YEP-at-INTERVIEW_INVITED semantics: either remove 'yep' from CALL_WORDS in services/jessi_onboarding.py so YEP no longer triggers a call at that state (per review spec), or update the review spec/test if current behaviour is intentional.
critical_code_review_comments: services/jessi_onboarding.py CALL_WORDS and YES_WORDS overlap on 'yep'/'yes'/'yeah'. At INTERVIEW_INVITED the CALL branch wins, so a user who casually replies 'yep' to the invite gets a real Twilio call placed instantly. Worth splitting or requiring an explicit 'call' keyword at that state.

GET /api/admin/onboarding-jessi returns rows[].waiting_on but the empty response ({rows:[], counts:{}}) has no seeded ids until seed_jessi_onboarding_demo.py runs; the list view happily renders an empty state so no UI regression, just something to note for future testing agents (re-run the seed before testing).

Note: 'YEP' at INTERVIEW_INVITED currently triggers a call attempt via CALL_WORDS overlap; if you re-run test_yep_at_invited_does_not_advance in test_jessi_onboarding_review_346.py it will still fail until the code or the spec is updated. Everything else is passing.
rca of the issue: YEP treated as call trigger at INTERVIEW_INVITED: services/jessi_onboarding.py line 41 CALL_WORDS = {..., 'yep', 'yes', 'yeah', ...}. Line 500 sets intent='call' if body in CALL_WORDS and state in ('INTERVIEW_INVITED', ...). Downstream this advances the state to INTERVIEW_STARTED via _place_call(). Fix: remove ambiguous confirmatory tokens ('yep', 'yes', 'yeah') from CALL_WORDS at INTERVIEW_INVITED, or gate the CALL intent on state != INTERVIEW_INVITED unless the body actually contains the word 'call' or 'ring'. Reproduction: POST /api/webhooks/twilio/incoming with From=+15005550077 To=+14352203414 Body=YEP after a fresh seed -> state flips to INTERVIEW_STARTED within ~2 s.
